terminology.meaning: Supplied by the team's equipment room to players/staff; not necessarily worn in a game
Prepared for a specific game/season but not confirmed worn (lower value than game-worn)
Worn during pre-game warm-ups (not game action)
Worn/used in game action; MeiGray/Hunt define as authenticated use during game
Item matched to game photography by unique marks
Issued to a named player (Fanatics label)
Team/partner itself attests use; The Realest terminology
Letter of authenticity, e.g. from team or athletic trainer
MeiGray tag with registration number verifiable via 888-463-4472
Length-added pro sizes on shooting shirts/warm-ups

terminology.term: Pro cut, PE (player exclusive), XL+2 / 4XL+3 / 3XLT, tear away / tearaway / rip away / breakaway / popper pants, Nike Team / Elite tags, Champion Pro Cut, Reebok Authentic on-court, Made in USA team tags, sewn-in name/number tags
terminology.meaning: Common collector terms - NOT source-verified this session (search budget exhausted); treat as working vocabulary only

counterfeit_red_flags.flag: Retail products named 'Team Issue' / 'Locker Issued' (e.g. Nike Texas 'KD Team Issue Tee', adidas 'Locker Issued by Pregame') are mass-retail lines, not equipment-room stock
'Authentic' shooting shirts sold by retailers (NBA Store/Fanatics on-court apparel, Stadium Goods 'NBA authentic shooting shirt') are retail authentic, not team-issued
'Game-issued' does not mean worn - even official NBA listings note items could not be photo-matched
Missing or unverifiable registry tag - verify MeiGray MGS numbers via toll-free line
Auction-archive descriptions are seller claims ('presented as team-issued'); require provenance chain
NCAA compliance: items sold by athletes (not the department) may be impermissible benefits - Michigan investigated athletes selling team-issued shoes
Further generic flags (wrong tag font/country, missing tall-length size tags, stitched-on fake player tags, wholesale 'TI' in bulk from Asia) - NOT source-verified this session
